Class DrawHandler

java.lang.Object
handlers.DrawHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener, javafx.event.EventHandler<javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent>
Direct Known Subclasses:
LineHandler, OvalHandler, RectHandler
public class DrawHandler extends Object implements javafx.event.EventHandler<javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent>
The DrawHandler class manages mouse events during the creation of a new shape on a ShapeCanvas. It listens for press, drag, and release events to define a MyShape object’s geometry interactively.

This is the base class for specific shape-drawing handlers (e.g., LineHandler, RectHandler, OvalHandler), and can be extended to support different types of shapes.

Responsibilities:

  • Capture the first mouse position to define the starting point of a shape.
  • Track mouse dragging to dynamically update the shape’s endpoint and redraw the canvas.
  • Finalize and register the completed shape when the mouse is released.

Implements EventHandler for MouseEvent.

  • Method Details

    • mousePressed

      protected void mousePressed(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent e)
      Invoked when the mouse is pressed — this marks the beginning of drawing a new shape. The first point (p1) of the shape is initialized based on the mouse position.
      Parameters:
      e - the MouseEvent representing the mouse press

    • mouseDragged

      protected void mouseDragged(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent e)
      Invoked continuously as the mouse is dragged after the initial press. Updates the second point (p2) of the shape in real time and repaints the canvas to provide immediate visual feedback.
      Parameters:
      e - the MouseEvent representing the mouse drag

    • mouseReleased

      protected void mouseReleased(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent e)
      Invoked when the mouse button is released — this finalizes the shape. The shape is added to the canvas and the temporary drawing state is cleared.
      Parameters:
      e - the MouseEvent representing the mouse release
